currentUser.name: Elena Vance
currentUser.bio: Architect and coastal hiker looking for easygoing travel companions to split boutique stays, sunset ferries, and local food walks.

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.summary: Cliffside Cycladic villages, volcanic caldera sailing, and terracotta beaches ideal for sharing sunset villas and island catamarans.

famousPlaces.name: Oia Blue Domes & Caldera Walk
famousPlaces.description: Marble footpaths winding past whitewashed cave houses and panoramic Aegean caldera viewpoints.

famousPlaces.name: Akrotiri Red Beach Cove
famousPlaces.description: Dramatic iron-rich volcanic sea cliffs framing clear turquoise swimming water near ancient Akrotiri.

destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.summary: Centuries-old shrines, cedar mountain trails, and serene wooden machiya townhouses where splitting multi-bedroom stays cuts lodging nearly in half.

famousPlaces.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha Gates
famousPlaces.description: Thousands of vermilion torii gates ascending wooded Mount Inari with quiet shrines along the ridge.

famousPlaces.name: Kinkaku-ji Golden Pavilion
famousPlaces.description: Gold-leaf Zen pavilion reflected across Kyoko-chi mirror pond surrounded by maple and pine gardens.

destinations.name: Amalfi Coast
destinations.summary: Vertical lemon-grove villages, cliffside belvederes, and coastal boat charters designed for small groups sharing private drivers and villas.

famousPlaces.name: Positano Cliffside & Spiaggia Grande
famousPlaces.description: Stacked pastel hillside terraces overlooking the Tyrrhenian cove, artisan linen alleys, and ferry pier.

famousPlaces.name: Villa Cimbrone Terrace, Ravello
famousPlaces.description: Historic stone infinity belvedere lined with marble busts perched 365 meters above the coastline.

destinations.name: Banff & Lake Louise
destinations.summary: Glacial turquoise lakes, alpine ridge trails, and cozy timber lodges where sharing an SUV and mountain cabin dramatically lowers daily costs.

famousPlaces.name: Moraine Lake & Ten Peaks
famousPlaces.description: Electric-blue glacially fed lake mirroring jagged Rocky Mountain peaks and larch forest trails.

famousPlaces.name: Sulphur Mountain Ridge Boardwalk
famousPlaces.description: Elevated alpine timber boardwalk linking panoramic viewpoints across the Bow Valley.

travelers.name: Marcus Reyes
travelers.bio: Product photographer planning early-morning shoots in Oia and a shared catamaran sail around the caldera. Happy to handle route logistics.

travelers.name: Sora Takahashi
travelers.bio: Tea enthusiast and urban sketcher visiting Kyoto shrines and Uji teahouses. Looking for 2–3 respectful companions to share a traditional machiya.

travelers.name: Clara Lindqvist
travelers.bio: Trail runner and architectural history fan heading to the Amalfi Coast. Hoping to split a private driver from Naples and hike Path of the Gods.

travelers.name: Devon Brooks
travelers.bio: Renting an AWD SUV out of Calgary for Banff & Lake Louise sunrise hikes. Seeking 2–3 fellow hikers to split fuel, park passes, and a timber chalet.

travelers.name: Nadia Al-Mansoor
travelers.bio: Culinary writer mapping out tavernas in Santorini and sunset cliff walks. Looking for friendly solo travelers who love long dinners and morning swims.

travelers.name: Liam O’Connor
travelers.bio: Backpacking Kansai on a smart budget—early Fushimi Inari hikes, Nishiki Market street food, and day trips to Nara.

tripIntents.note: Found a 2-bedroom caldera terrace near Imerovigli—looking for 2 more to split lodging and a sunset boat charter.
Focused on Red Beach, Akrotiri ruins, and seaside tavernas. Flexible on splitting a rental car from the port.
Early starts at Fushimi Inari before crowds, then slow afternoons in Higashiyama cafes and Kinkaku-ji.
Splitting a clean 4-bed guesthouse near Kyoto Station and sharing ramen & Nishiki market tastings.
Planning Positano ferries, Villa Cimbrone gardens in Ravello, and the Path of the Gods hike.
Already reserved shuttle slots for Moraine Lake sunrise and looking to share an SUV and Canmore cabin.

messages.body: Hey Elena! Saw you are eyeing Santorini in mid-May. Another traveler and I are looking at a 4-person villa in Imerovigli to bring lodging down around $60/night each.
That sounds ideal—I would love to join for the sunrise Oia walk and split a rental car for Red Beach.
Awesome! Let me know your arrival flight times whenever you narrow them down.
